f3_program: collection("sofia_family.three_week_orange_purchases", "weekly_orange_quantity", "sofia_family", source("the total quantity of oranges they would have bought after the three weeks"))

member("sofia_family.three_week_orange_purchases", "sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.quantity", source("buys 10kgs of oranges to be used in their home for the week. While at the store, Sofia's father calls and says they're to add 5 more kgs"))
member("sofia_family.three_week_orange_purchases", "sofia_family.orange_purchases.second_week.quantity", source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))
member("sofia_family.three_week_orange_purchases", "sofia_family.orange_purchases.third_week.quantity", source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))
observe(at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.base.quantity", "first_week"), 10, "kg", source("buys 10kgs of oranges"))
observe(at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.additional.quantity", "first_week"), 5, "kg", source("add 5 more kgs"))

sum_relation(at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.quantity", "first_week"), at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.base.quantity", "first_week"), at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.additional.quantity", "first_week"), source("buys 10kgs of oranges to be used in their home for the week. While at the store, Sofia's father calls and says they're to add 5 more kgs"))

multiple(at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.second_week.quantity", "second_week"), at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.quantity", "first_week"), 2, source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))

multiple(at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.third_week.quantity", "third_week"), at("sofia_family.orange_purchases.first_week.quantity", "first_week"), 2, source("for the next coming two weeks they'll have to buy twice as many oranges each week"))
query("sum", "sofia_family.three_week_orange_purchases", "after_three_weeks")
assumptions: Interpreted "twice as many" in each of the next two weeks as twice the complete first-week purchase, including the additional 5 kg.
The weekly earnings require deriving the open-day count from named weekday exclusions and seven-day calendar knowledge; F3-v1 has no weekday-complement or calendar-ontology form.

f3_program: observe(at("new_video_game.cost", "current"), 60, "dollar", source("costs $60"))
collection("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish", "fish", "bucky", source("He caught five fish this Sunday"))
observe(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), 5, "count", source("He caught five fish this Sunday"))
collection("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "fish_species_group", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish", source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
member("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout", source("60% were trout"))
member("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", "bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill", source("the rest were blue-gill"))
partition("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.species_groups", at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), source("60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
percent_of(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.count", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.count", "this_sunday"), 60, source("60% were trout"))
observe(at("bucky.trout.earnings_per_fish", "current"), 5, "dollar_per_fish", source("$5 from trout"))
observe(at("bucky.blue_gill.earnings_per_fish", "current"), 4, "dollar_per_fish", source("$4 from blue-gill"))

rate_relation(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.earnings", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.trout.earnings_per_fish", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.count", "this_sunday"), source("He can earn $5 from trout and $4 from blue-gill. He caught five fish this Sunday. If 60% were trout"))

rate_relation(at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.earnings", "this_sunday"), at("bucky.blue_gill.earnings_per_fish", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.count", "this_sunday"), source("He can earn $5 from trout and $4 from blue-gill. He caught five fish this Sunday. If 60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
produce("last_weekend_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), 35, source("Last weekend he earned $35"))

produce("this_sunday_trout_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.trout.earnings", "this_sunday"), source("He can earn $5 from trout and $4 from blue-gill. He caught five fish this Sunday. If 60% were trout"))

produce("this_sunday_blue_gill_earnings", "bucky", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("bucky.this_sunday.caught_fish.blue_gill.earnings", "this_sunday"), source("He can earn $5 from trout and $4 from blue-gill. He caught five fish this Sunday. If 60% were trout, and the rest were blue-gill"))
query("difference", at("bucky.fish_sale_earnings.amount", "current"), at("new_video_game.cost", "current"))
assumptions: Interpreted the $5 and $4 amounts as per-fish earnings for trout and blue-gill, respectively.
Interpreted the five fish caught this Sunday as sold and all described earnings as available toward the game; no other funds are included.

f3_program: collection("three_friends.video_game_sale_proceeds", "sale_proceeds_amount", "three_friends", source("three friends sold their video games"))
member("three_friends.video_game_sale_proceeds", "ryan.video_game_sale.proceeds", source("Ryan, the first of the three friends"))
member("three_friends.video_game_sale_proceeds", "jason.video_game_sale.proceeds", source("Jason from his sales"))
member("three_friends.video_game_sale_proceeds", "zachary.video_game_sale.proceeds", source("Zachary from selling his video games"))

offset(at("ryan.video_game_sale.proceeds", "sale"), at("jason.video_game_sale.proceeds", "sale"), 50, "dollar", source("Ryan, the first of the three friends, received $50 more than Jason from his sales"))
percent_more(at("jason.video_game_sale.proceeds", "sale"), at("zachary.video_game_sale.proceeds", "sale"), 30, source("Jason received 30% more money than Zachary from selling his video games"))
observe(at("zachary.video_game_sale.games_sold.count", "sale"), 40, "count", source("Zachary sold 40 games"))
observe(at("zachary.video_game_sale.price_per_game", "sale"), 5, "dollar_per_game", source("$5 each"))

rate_relation(at("zachary.video_game_sale.proceeds", "sale"), at("zachary.video_game_sale.price_per_game", "sale"), at("zachary.video_game_sale.games_sold.count", "sale"), source("Zachary sold 40 games at $5 each"))
query("sum", "three_friends.video_game_sale_proceeds", "sale")

member("julio.three_week_earnings", "julio.commission.third_week.amount", source("Julio receives a $1 commission for every customer that buys in Edgars Fashion Store"))
